tabs.html:
PC Power PP-GS2407 BK Crystal Glass Mesh ATX Desktop Gaming Case

The PC Power PP-GS2407 WH is a premium mid-tower ATX gaming case that combines striking aesthetics with efficient airflow and expandability. Designed for gamers and PC builders, it features a white chassis with crystal-clear tempered glass and a high-airflow mesh front panel.

Key Features:

  • Motherboard Support: ATX, Micro-ATX, and Mini-ITX
  • Cooling System: Includes 4 pre-installed 120mm ARGB fans (3 front, 1 rear) for superior airflow and lighting
  • Liquid Cooling Support: Up to 360mm radiator in front, 240mm on top, and 120mm at the rear
  • Drive Bays: Supports 2 x 3.5" HDD and 2 x 2.5" SSD
  • Expansion Slots: 7 standard slots for GPUs and other add-ons
  • Front I/O Panel: 1 x USB 3.0, 2 x USB 2.0, audio ports, and RGB control button
  • Tempered Glass Panel: Showcases internal components and lighting setups
  • Dust Filters: Removable filters on the front, top, and bottom for easy maintenance
  • Cable Management: Built-in grommets and routing space for clean builds
  • Build Quality: Material: 0.5mm SPCC steel with tempered glass and metal mesh
  • Color: Black
  • Dimensions: 455mm (L) x 215mm (W) x 480mm (H)
  • Weight: Approximately 7 kg
